title: Dual-Stack IPv4 and IPv6 Static Routing
summary: Configure dual-stack IPv4 and IPv6 addressing, enable IPv6 unicast routing, configure static routes, and verify end-to-end reachability across two routers and switches.
learning_objectives: Configure IPv4 and IPv6 global unicast addressing on Cisco router interfaces
Enable global IPv6 unicast routing (ipv6 unicast-routing) on Cisco IOS routers
Configure next-hop IPv4 and IPv6 static routes between two router networks
Verify Layer 2 forwarding across Catalyst switches and Layer 3 end-to-end connectivity

source.origin: Original contributor lab by CyberSphinxxx upgraded with accurate IPv6 unicast-routing and Layer 2 switching theory
